subject: Q4 invoice: country-of-supply mismatch affecting reverse-charge (VAT proof requested)
messages:
From: Anna Kowalska <anna.kowalska@finova.pl>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@klient.co
Date: 2026-12-12T09:14:00Z
Subject: Invoice 4532 - place of supply flagged

Hi Rishi,

We received invoice #4532 (PDF attached) but our AP system flagged the invoice for reverse-charge because the place-of-supply on your invoice is listed as Poland.

Our legal/tax team is asking for confirmation of the VAT treatment: KlientCo has a UK HQ but bills through a Polish subsidiary for certain EU customers. Can you confirm which entity issued the invoice and whether Redwood intends reverse-charge (self-assessment) or to collect VAT?

We've attached the invoice and our internal GL code for reference. If you need a VAT registration certificate or any other proof, please let us know. Our payment run is scheduled for 27 Dec, so we'd like to resolve how the invoice should be posted.

Thanks,
Anna Kowalska
Head of Finance Operations
KlientCo
Attachments: Q4-2026_KLIENTCO_invoice_4532.pdf (pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kowalska <anna.kowalska@finova.pl>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice 4532 - place of supply flagged

Hi Anna — thanks for the flag and for the invoice copy.

Short answers up front: the invoice was issued by Redwood Inference (Redwood EU Operations Sp. z o.o.), our EU-hosted billing entity, and our standard handling for B2B EU customers is reverse-charge where the buyer provides a valid intra-EU VAT ID and qualifies as a taxable person in that member state.

To unblock your AP team for the Dec 27 run we need either:
- a VAT registration document for KlientCo PL subsidiary (if the Polish VAT number is what you'll use), or
- confirmation that the UK entity is the actual buyer and a UK VAT number will be supplied (in which case different treatment applies post-Brexit).

Cc'ing our billing/tax ops team — Ben and Vanessa — to run a quick VIES check and confirm how the invoice should be re-classed if necessary.

I'll hold payment queries from our side until we get the proof you can provide.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: (none)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kowalska <anna.kowalska@finova.pl>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T08:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice 4532 - place of supply flagged

Hi Anna,

Thanks for the quick note — I ran a preliminary VIES check and we've pulled a short validation log (attached). Two quick observations:

1) The VAT number presented on the invoice resolves to a Polish VAT registration but our KYC records for the customer indicate primary tax residency tied to the UK holding company. That mismatch is why your AP system flagged reverse-charge.
2) For reverse-charge to be appropriate we need evidence that the Polish entity is acting as the taxable person for this transaction (examples: VAT certificate showing active registration, invoices routing confirmation, or a self-assertion letter on company letterhead).

Could you:
- Confirm which legal entity is contracting with Redwood for the Q4 subscription (legal name + registered address)
- Share the VAT certificate for the Polish entity (or the UK VAT number if the UK entity is buyer)

If you prefer, we can accept a scanned VAT certificate plus a short email from your legal/tax team asserting the place-of-supply. Once we have that we'll update the invoice metadata and re-issue under the correct tax treatment (reverse-charge annotation) so your AP can post without blocking.

Attached: vat_validation_log.csv (contains VIES lookup attempts and timestamps).

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Billing & Tax Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: vat_validation_log.csv (csv)
From: Anna Kowalska <anna.kowalska@finova.pl>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@klient.co
Date: 2026-12-20T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice 4532 - place of supply flagged

Hi Vanessa / Rishi,

Apologies for the delay — attached is our Polish VAT registration certificate for KlientCo Sp. z o.o. (file: KlientCo_VAT_certificate_PL-55678.pdf). Our Polish subsidiary is the contracting party for Digital Services in the EU region and should be recorded as the buyer for Q4 invoices.

Please re-issue the invoice with the reverse-charge note: "VAT reverse-charge applies — Article 194 VAT Directive. Customer is a taxable person in the issuing member state." and include the Polish VAT number in the invoice metadata. Once re-issued we'll proceed with the Dec 27 payment run.

For your records the certificate expiry is 2028-05-31. If you need a signed self-assertion on letterhead, I can have legal send it, but the attached certificate should suffice.

Thanks,
Anna Kowalska
Head of Finance Operations
KlientCo
Attachments: KlientCo_VAT_certificate_PL-55678.pdf (pdf)
